steps.en: Install and open the desktop app (the magnitude CLI ships with it)
steps.zh: 安装并打开桌面 App，它自带 magnitude 命令行

steps.en: Profiles your machine and ranks catalog models by estimated tok/s, accuracy and memory
steps.zh: 给你的机器做硬件画像，按估算的 tok/s、精度、内存给模型排名

steps.en: Pick a recommended model in Discover and download it
steps.zh: 在 Discover 里挑一个推荐模型并下载

steps.en: Tunes context size and speculative decoding for your hardware
steps.zh: 按你的硬件调好上下文长度与投机解码

steps.en: Connect the agent you already use, in Connections
steps.zh: 在 Connections 里接上你已经在用的 agent

steps.en: Serves it locally on OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, loading models on demand
steps.zh: 本地起 OpenAI / Anthropic 兼容端点，按需加载和卸载模型

value.en: You stop guessing which model fits this machine — and your existing agent runs on it without hand-edited config
value.zh: 不用再猜这台机器能跑哪个模型，现有 agent 也不用手改配置就能用上

sources: https://github.com/magnitudedev/magnitude README Get started + Why Magnitude (desktop app, Discover, Connections, bundled CLI, tok/s estimates, speculative decoding, on-demand load/unload)
cli/src/commands/inference.ts (magnitude hardware, catalog recommendations, catalog pull)
